content.content:
INC-203  Verified gross mass leaves out the container itself
status: open   priority: P1   area: cargo   reported: 2026-08-27 by terminal-safety

The VGM figures we declare are lighter than the weighbridge readings by a couple of
tonnes per box. Verified gross mass has to include the container's tare as well as the
cargo; we only count the cargo.

Acceptance:
  verifiedGrossMassTonnes returns cargo plus tare in tonnes: a box with 20000 kg of cargo
  and a 2200 kg tare has a VGM of 22200 kg (22 tonnes and 200 kg), and
  manifestWeightTonnes sums those values.

Files:
  src/cargo/manifest.ts

content.text:
All 28 tests pass, including the new ones verifying the fix.

Fixed INC-203: `verifiedGrossMassTonnes` in `src/cargo/manifest.ts` was only counting `cargoKg`, dropping the container tare. It now sums `cargoKg + tareKg` before converting to tonnes, so `manifestWeightTonnes` correctly aggregates true VGM. Added tests covering the acceptance example (20000 kg cargo + 2200 kg tare = 22.2 t) and a multi-container sum.
